CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   B. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

12. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
